- **`remove_item/3`:** It removes units of an item. If you remove as many units as the cart holds, or more, the item is removed. Removing an item that isn't in the cart changes nothing.
- **`apply_code/2`:** It takes the code as a string. "SAVE10" and "FREESHIP" return `{:ok, cart}`. Any other string, including lowercase "save10", returns `{:error, :unknown_
